title: A Tomb Chamber in the Syrian Orphanage, Jerusalem
author: D. C. B[aramki]
location_note: Grounds of the Syrian (Schneller) Orphanage, Jerusalem; no map reference; placed by name.
notes: Cleared March 1931: plastered chamber with built entrance, three rock-sunk graves and a central pit, three more graves in a rock-cutting in front; gold ear-rings (one dated to the 2nd c. AD by Rostovtzeff), glass bracelet, Roman lamp, late Roman ribbed sherds.

features.subtype: plastered tomb chamber with three rock-sunk graves and central pit; three further rock-sunk graves in a rock-cutting in front
features.period: second century AD (ear-ring, after Rostovtzeff); late Roman ribbed sherds
features.quote: it was found to contain three rock-sunk graves
